'''Pepper Poppers''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

The [[Bookseller]] trades 2 Pepper Poppers for 1 [[Stardew Valley Almanac]]. It may also randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. [[Shane]] may occasionally send the player Pepper Poppers in the mail as a gift. He also sells up to 3 sets of 3 Pepper Poppers in his [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|30|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each. One can sometimes be purchased at the [[Stardew Valley Fair]] for {{Price|250|token}}. One Pepper Poppers may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Pepper Poppers are not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Pepper Poppers are used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt180.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring|Tunnelers Jersey]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a brown dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Pepper Poppers are not used in any [[quests]].
